response.sql:
WITH transaction_sentiment AS (
  SELECT 
    tr.transreg,
    tr.ordertypedist,
    AVG(sf.shortintrt) as avg_shortintrt,
    AVG(sf.optvolrt) as avg_optvolrt
  FROM transactionrecord tr
  INNER JOIN sentimentandfundamentals sf ON tr.transreg = sf.transref
  GROUP BY tr.transreg, tr.ordertypedist
),
ordertypemix_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    tr.ordertypedist,
    AVG(sf.shortintrt) as ordertypemix_avg_shortintrt
  FROM transactionrecord tr
  INNER JOIN sentimentandfundamentals sf ON tr.transreg = sf.transref
  GROUP BY tr.ordertypedist
)
SELECT 
  ts.transreg,
  ts.ordertypedist,
  ts.avg_shortintrt,
  ts.avg_optvolrt,
  CASE 
    WHEN ota.ordertypemix_avg_shortintrt IS NOT NULL AND ota.ordertypemix_avg_shortintrt != 0
    THEN ts.avg_shortintrt / ota.ordertypemix_avg_shortintrt
    ELSE NULL
  END as shortintrt_ratio
FROM transaction_sentiment ts
LEFT JOIN ordertypemix_averages ota ON ts.ordertypedist = ota.ordertypedist
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN shortintrt_ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC,
  shortintrt_ratio DESC;

assumptions.assumption: "Average short interest for its order type mix" means the average of shortintrt across all sentiment records for transactions with that ordertypedist, not the average of per-transaction short-interest averages.

alternatives.interpretation: "Average short interest for its order type mix" is calculated as the average of the transaction-level averages (i.e., equal weighting per transaction rather than per sentiment record).
